    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.caseSuppressionChecks</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>This script include checks the livestatus of  a record in business process stages table.</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>caseSuppressionChecks</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var caseSuppressionChecks = Class.create();
caseSuppressionChecks.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},


    isStatusLive: function(status) {

        //MSSOTIQUBE-1093 --> Fetch the logging property from system property
        var enable_logging = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o.caseSuppressionChecks_logging', 'false') === 'true';

        //MSSOTIQUBE-1093 --> Error handling if unable to check the livestatus of the record
        try {

            var isStatusLiveCheck = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o_business_process_stage');
            // isStatusLiveCheck.get(status);

            //MSSOTIQUBE-1093 --> Log error if the record cannot be found
            if (!isStatusLiveCheck.get(status)) {
                if (enable_logging)
                    gs.info('caseSuppressionChecks- Error: ' + 'Record: ' + status + ' not found');
            }
			
            return isStatusLiveCheck.is_live;

        } catch (error) {
			// Logging any unexpected error
            gs.error('caseSuppressionChecks- Error while checking the livestatus for status: ' + status +' Error: ' + error.message);
        }
    },

    type: 'caseSuppressionChecks'
};]]></script>
